title: RTP is specified as a transport protocol for real-time applications
summary: RTP is specified as a transport protocol for real-time applications.
body: RFC 3550 specifies RTP, a transport protocol for real-time applications. The source says: "Jacobson Packet Design July 2003 RTP: A Transport Protocol for Real-Time Applications Status of this Memo This document specifies an Internet standards track protocol for the Internet community, and requests discussion and suggestions for improvements." Real-time transport is the purpose named in the title. RTP does not, by that title, guarantee that a conversation arrives without loss. Loss and delay are properties the application has to tolerate or conceal.

sources.title: RFC 3550: RTP: A Transport Protocol for Real-Time Applications
sources.author: H. Schulzrinne, S. Casner, R. Frederick, and V. Jacobson
